reasons.A: Earnest and reflective, with measured explanatory sentences and a sober close; it lacks the passage's deadpan irony, mock dialogue and sting.
reasons.B: Dry, ironic understatement ('unable to stand at all') comes close to the author's tone, but its long, even, essayistic sentences and dutiful historian's close are more sober than the passage's quick jab.
reasons.C: Brisk, deadpan irony ('this theological argument', 'invited to reflect'), direct address to the reader and an imagined quoted objection match the passage's mock-dialogue stance and punchy close most closely, with only slight over-layering.
